title: Simple SearchBar
description: SearchBar is a lightweight mod that adds a simple search bar for (Fakepixel) Skyblock.
body: # SearchBar *(Yes, I’m bad at naming things)* SearchBar is a lightweight mod that adds a simple search bar for (Fakepixel) Skyblock. ## Features * Search for items in your inventory * * Search inside any currently opened container * Calculator in the search bar (yes i know you failed math) (yes search includes tooltip and you can search for attributes)
